caseName: Radio Officers' Union of the Commercial Telegraphers Union v. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: Radio Officers' Union of the Commercial Telegraphers Union, AFL v. National Labor Relations Board
attorneys: Herbert S. Thatcher and Abner H. Silverman for petitioner., Acting Solicitor General Stern, George J. Bott, David P. Findling, Mozart G. Ratner and Elizabeth W. Weston filed a memorandum for respondent stating that they do not oppose the granting of the petition limited to the question of the interpretation of § 8 (a) (3) of the National Labor Relations Act.

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari granted.

Acting Solicitor General Stern, George J. Bott, David P. Findling, Mozart G. Ratner and Elizabeth W. Weston filed a memorandum for respondent stating that they do not oppose the granting of the petition limited to the question of the interpretation of § 8 (a) (3) of the National Labor Relations Act.
